chapter: West Coast trip and Mildred's circle
title: Mildred in Los Angeles speakeasies; the audition for Rube Wolff
summary: Mildred moved to Los Angeles where she was a table singer, and got Al Rinker and Bing an audition that led to Rube Wolff's Metropolitan Theater.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
